list.name: agent_type
list.label: Agent Type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT agent_type FROM gateway.commands ORDER BY agent_type

list.name: command_id
list.label: Command
list.query:
SELECT c.id::text AS __value,
       c.id::text || ' | ' || c.agent_type || ' | ' || LEFT(c.message, 50) || ' (' || to_char(c.created_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') || ')' AS __text
FROM gateway.commands c
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (completed_at - created_at))::numeric, 1) AS duration FROM gateway.commands WHERE id = ${command_id}::int
SELECT COUNT(*) AS responses FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int
SELECT COUNT(*) AS text_responses FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int AND response_type = 'text'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS code_blocks FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int AND response_type = 'code'
SELECT agent_type FROM gateway.commands WHERE id = ${command_id}::int
SELECT status FROM gateway.commands WHERE id = ${command_id}::int

SELECT 'user' AS role, c.message AS content, 'command' AS response_type, c.created_at AS ts, c.agent_type, NULL::text AS payload FROM gateway.commands c WHERE c.id = ${command_id}::int UNION ALL SELECT 'agent' AS role, r.content, r.response_type, r.created_at AS ts, r.agent_type, r.payload::text FROM gateway.responses r WHERE r.command_id = ${command_id}::int ORDER BY ts ASC
SELECT created_at, LEFT(content, 500) AS content FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int AND response_type = 'thinking' ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT created_at, response_type, LEFT(content, 300) AS content, (payload->>'exit_code')::int AS exit_code FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int AND response_type IN ('tool_use', 'tool_result') ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT created_at, LEFT(content, 1000) AS content FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int AND response_type = 'code' ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT created_at, LEFT(content, 500) AS content FROM gateway.responses WHERE command_id = ${command_id}::int AND response_type = 'stderr' ORDER BY created_at ASC
